scope: Static native and EventFlow evidence from island-score calculation/save copy through Isabelle's first-K.K.-live readiness branch and public-announcement stage request.

evidence_policy.EF: Direct BFEVFL action, condition, result assignment, or subflow edge.
evidence_policy.MSBT: Extracted message-member text and labels; proves visible string mapping, not its runtime presentation.
evidence_policy.STATIC_NATIVE: Raw AArch64 code, callsite, or data reference; not a game execution.
evidence_policy.OPEN_JOIN: Adjacent static endpoints exist, but the connecting runtime dispatch or execution is not established.

native_functions.role: Aggregates per-category block counters, applies the native weight table, adds structure/facility contributions, and updates the in-memory score manager. Not executed by the existing score fixtures.
Copies the category-10 grid and aggregate outputs to the score-save member.
Loads the score-manager pointer through global 0x32d3f68 and calls 0x15c61f0.
Save callback; obtains the score member view at 0x24fdb0 with length 0x250 and calls 0x15c68c0 on the same manager pointer.
EventFlow VillageScoreCheckNatural query; compares its threshold parameter to saved score offset +0x240.

fields.0x000: u16[18][16] category-10 half-unit counts per block; VillageScoreVeryMessy reads this grid
fields.0x240: f32 Natural; VillageScoreCheckNatural reads this field
fields.0x244: f32 Life; VillageScoreCheckLife reads this field
fields.0x248: i32 category-9 count; VillageScorePutUnitIconNum reads this field
fields.0x24c: i32 category-5 count; VillageScoreCheckTreeNum reads this field
